method:
build_v23.py - v23_costs.json: the REAL per-side cost of V2/V3 swaps of $20-200 on the backtests' coins, from receipts.
Per swap (single V2/V3 WETH pool, status 1): mid = the pool's price just BEFORE the swap (V2: reserves rebuilt from Sync
and the Swap amounts; V3: sqrtP rebuilt from the exact output-side formula, checked by the implied fee which lands on the
tier to 3 decimals). pool_cost = 1 - value out at mid / value in  (= LP fee + price impact). tax = token-level transfer tax
(taxcoin). tool = a third-party router/bot fee skimmed in tokens (not paid by OUR executor). router_eth = visible ETH-side
router skim. OUR-BOT side cost = pool_cost + token tax (+ our own flat fee, charged separately by the engines).
per_coin_note: key = coin|kind:quote, the engine pool key; one pool kind never borrows another kind's impact
